breakdown.description: The transverse modulus should follow the inverse rule of mixtures, not the parallel rule.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the parallel rule of mixtures (E_T = V_f E_f + V_m E_m) instead of the inverse rule of mixtures (1/E_T = V_f/E_f + V_m/E_m). The incorrect formula from the incomplete prompt was repeated verbatim, and the resulting calculation (139.6 GPa) reflects the wrong formula. The ground truth requires using the inverse rule of mixtures, which would yield a much lower transverse modulus (~9.4 GPa for the given values).
